name: swsd
description: SolarWinds Service Desk tools and Windows companion app for connection setup, custom profiles, updates, and diagnostics.

interface.longDescription: Windows desktop only. Includes SWSD MCP 3.4.0 with 146 tools across the complete Operations profile, ten interactive MCP Apps widgets, and a Windows companion app. Start a new local Work or Codex chat and ask: Set up SolarWinds Service Desk on this computer. The companion app provides private connection setup, a searchable tool guide, built-in and custom profiles, appearance themes, updates, redacted diagnostics, and offline release notes. Reopen it from SWSD Setup in the Start menu. Tokens stay in Windows Credential Manager. Restart the desktop app and start a new chat after installation or changing profiles. Requires Node.js 24.15+ within version 24 or Node.js 26+; Node 25 is not supported. SolarWinds account permissions determine access.
